svg.text: Inside events.jsonl.gz: 4-Bucket Credit Billing, Cache Discounts & Turn-by-Turn Context Snowball
Mined from 2,895 per-turn session.usage_record payloads across all 224 runs · Why 95% vs. 75% cache discounts and Turn-1 tool schemas drive cost
A. Where the Credits Go: 4-Bucket Billing Split (8 Tasks Total)
Uncached Input vs. Cache Write (1.25×) vs. Cache Read (95% / 90% / 75% off) vs. Output + Reasoning
Why Opus 5.5 & GPT-6.1-Sol Cut Credits So Sharply:
95% cache-read discount (20 cr/1M vs 50 cr/1M on Opus 5) slashes Opus 5.5 CacheRead from 498 cr → 76 cr (-85%).
B. Turn-by-Turn Context Snowball on three_d (Cumulative Input)
Stopping at Turn 10–11 reads 0.30M–0.46M tokens; looping to Turn 112 reads 8.97M tokens
Quadratic O(N²) zone: every extra render-inspect turn re-reads session history + images
C. Turn-1 Context Footprint on Identical Prompt (three_d)
76%–83% of Turn-1 input is CLI tool schemas (38–39 tools), cached once & read at 90%–95% off
